units.zh: 孝惠皇帝諱衷，字正度，武帝第二子也。
units.en: Emperor Hui, whose personal name was Sima Zhong and courtesy name Zhengdu, was Emperor Wu’s second son.
units.literal: The Filial and Kind Emperor, taboo name Zhong, courtesy name Zhengdu, was the second son of Emperor Wu.

units.zh: 泰始三年，立爲皇太子，時年九歲。
units.en: In 267, when he was nine years old, he was named heir apparent.
units.literal: In the third year of Taishi, he was established as crown prince; at the time he was nine sui.

units.zh: 太熙元年四月己酉，武帝崩。
units.en: In the fourth month of the first year of Taixi, on the day jiyou, Emperor Wu died.
units.literal: In the first year of Taixi, on the jiyou day of the fourth month, Emperor Wu died.

units.zh: 是日，皇太子即皇帝位，大赦，改元爲永熙。
units.en: That same day the heir apparent ascended the throne, ordered a general amnesty, and adopted the reign title Yongxi.
units.literal: That same day the crown prince assumed the imperial throne, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Yongxi.

units.zh: 尊皇后楊氏曰皇太后，立妃賈氏爲皇后。
units.en: Empress Yang was elevated to empress dowager, and his consort Lady Jia was installed as empress.
units.literal: The empress, Lady Yang, was honored as empress dowager; Consort Jia was established as empress.

units.zh: 夏五月辛未，葬武皇帝於峻陽陵。
units.en: In the fifth lunar month of summer, Emperor Wu was interred at the Junyang imperial tomb.
units.literal: In summer, on the xinwei day of the fifth month, Emperor Wu was buried at Junyang Mausoleum.

units.zh: 丙子，增天下位一等，預喪事者二等，復租調一年，二千石已上皆封關中侯。
units.en: On the bingzi day, court ranks were advanced one step nationwide, two for those engaged in the funeral, taxes and corvée were waived for a year, and every official from prefect upward received the noble title marquis within the passes.
units.literal: On the bingzi day, ranks under Heaven were raised one grade; those involved in mourning rites, two grades; rent and labor levies were remitted for one year; all officials of two thousand piculs and above were enfeoffed as marquises within the passes.

units.zh: 以太尉楊駿爲太傅，輔政。
units.en: Grand Commandant Yang Jun was appointed grand tutor to oversee state affairs.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Yang Jun was made grand tutor and assisted the government.

units.zh: 秋八月壬午，立廣陵王遹爲皇太子，以中書監何劭爲太子太師，吏部尚書王戎爲太子太傅，衛將軍楊濟爲太子太保。
units.en: In autumn, on the renwu day of the eighth month, Sima Yu, prince of Guangling, was named crown prince; He Shao became his grand preceptor, Wang Rong his grand tutor, and Yang Ji his grand guardian.
units.literal: In autumn, on the renwu day of the eighth month, Prince Sima You of Guangling was established as crown prince; Director of the Secretariat He Shao was made grand preceptor of the heir apparent; Minister of the Ministry of Personnel Wang Rong was made grand tutor of the heir apparent; General of the Guards Yang Ji was made grand guardian of the heir apparent.

units.zh: 遣南中郎將石崇、射聲校尉胡奕、長水校尉趙俊、揚烈將軍趙歡將屯兵四出。
units.en: Shi Chong, Hu Yi, Zhao Jun, and Zhao Huan were sent out at the head of garrison forces in every direction.
units.literal: General of the Southern Gentlemen of the Household Shi Chong, Colonel of the Sound of Shooting Hu Yi, Colonel of the Long River Zhao Jun, and General Who Displays Ferocity Zhao Huan were dispatched leading garrison troops in four directions.

units.zh: 冬十月辛酉，以司空石鑒爲太尉，前鎮西將軍、隴西王泰爲司空。
units.en: In the tenth month, Shi Jian rose from minister of works to grand commandant, while Prince Tai of Longxi, lately general who had guarded the west, took the ministry of works.
units.literal: In winter, on the xinyou day of the tenth month, Minister of Works Shi Jian was made grand commandant; former General Who Guards the West, Prince Tai of Longxi, was made minister of works.

units.zh: 永平元年春正月乙酉朔，臨朝，不設樂。
units.en: On the yiyou new moon of the first month of spring in Yongping 1, the emperor held court without music.
units.literal: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Yongping, on the yiyou new moon, he attended court and did not set out music.

units.zh: 詔曰：「朕夙遭不造，淹恤在疚。
units.en: An edict ran: “From boyhood I have known bereavement I did not choose; mourning has long weighed upon me.
units.literal: An edict stated: “I from early on have encountered ill fortune not of my making; prolonged grief dwells in affliction.

units.zh: 賴祖宗遺靈，宰輔忠賢，得以眇身託于群后之上。
units.en: Thanks to the spirits of my forebears and to loyal, capable ministers, this slight frame has been set above the princes of the blood.
units.literal: Relying on the lingering numen of ancestors and forebears, and on the chief ministers’ loyalty and worthiness, I have been able to entrust my insignificant person above the host of lords.

units.zh: 昧於大道，不明于訓，戰戰兢兢，夕惕若厲。
units.en: I am dim to the great Way, slow to take instruction, and I tremble through the day, alert at night as though disaster were at hand.
units.literal: Dark regarding the great way, unclear in instruction, trembling with fear, in the evening watchful as if in danger.

units.zh: 乃者哀迷之際，三事股肱，惟社稷之重，率遵翼室之典，猶欲長奉先皇之制，是以有永熙之號。
units.en: In the confusion after my father’s death, the chief ministers, mindful of the altars of state, followed precedent for a minor on the throne and meant to keep his late Majesty’s institutions; that is why the reign was called Yongxi.
units.literal: Recently, amid the confusion of mourning, the three high ministers, the thighs and arms, considering the weight of altars and grain, all followed the canons of aiding the chamber, and still wished long to uphold the late emperor’s regulations; therefore there was the era name Yongxi.

units.zh: 然日月踰邁，已涉新年，開元易紀，禮之舊章。
units.en: Yet the seasons have turned, a new year has begun, and ritual expects a fresh reign title at such a renewal.
units.literal: Yet sun and moon pass beyond; already we have entered a new year; to open the first month and change the era tally is the old pattern of ritual.

units.zh: 其改永熙二年爲永平元年。」
units.en: Let the second year of Yongxi be renamed the first year of Yongping.”
units.literal: Let the second year of Yongxi be changed to the first year of Yongping.”

units.zh: 又詔子弟及群官並不得謁陵。
units.en: A further edict forbade imperial clansmen and officials to visit the imperial tombs.
units.literal: Another edict: imperial sons and younger brothers and all officials alike were not permitted to visit the mausoleum.

units.zh: 丙午，皇太子冠，丁未，見于太廟。
units.en: The crown prince came of age with the capping ceremony one day and was presented at the ancestral temple the next.
units.literal: On the bingwu day the crown prince underwent capping; on the dingwei day he appeared in the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 二月甲寅，賜王公已下帛各有差。
units.en: In the second month, princes, dukes, and officials down the scale received graded gifts of silk.
units.literal: In the second month, on the jiayin day, silk was granted to princes, dukes, and downward, each according to rank.

units.zh: 癸酉，鎮南將軍楚王瑋、鎮東將軍淮南王允來朝。
units.en: Prince Wei of Chu, who held the southern command, and Prince Yun of Huainan, who held the eastern command, arrived for audience at court.
units.literal: On the guiyou day, General Who Guards the South, Prince Sima Wei of Chu, and General Who Guards the East, Prince Sima Yun of Huainan, came to court audience.

units.zh: 戊寅，復置祕書監官。
units.en: The directorship of the Palace Library was restored.
units.literal: On the wuyin day, the office of director of the Palace Library was re-established.

units.zh: 三月辛卯，誅太傅楊駿，駿弟衛將軍珧，太子太保濟，中護軍張劭，散騎常侍段廣、楊邈，左將軍劉預，河南尹李斌，中書令蔣俊，東夷校尉文淑，尚書武茂，皆夷三族。
units.en: In the third month Yang Jun and his entire faction were put to death: his brother Yang Yao, Yang Ji, Zhang Shao, Duan Guang, Yang Miao, Liu Yu, Li Bin, Jiang Jun, Wen Shu, and Wu Mao, with every branch of their families extirpated.
units.literal: In the third month, on the xinmao day, Grand Tutor Yang Jun was executed; Jun’s younger brother General of the Guards Yang Yao, Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Yang Ji, Central Protector of the Army Zhang Shao, Cavalier Attendants-in-Ordinary Duan Guang and Yang Miao, General of the Left Liu Yu, Intendant of Henan Li Bin, Director of the Secretariat Jiang Jun, Colonel of Eastern Yi Tribes Wen Shu, and Minister Wu Mao—all were exterminated to the third degree of kin.

units.zh: 壬辰，大赦，改元。
units.en: A general amnesty followed, and the reign title was changed again.
units.literal: On the renchen day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

units.zh: 賈后矯詔廢皇太后爲庶人，徙于金墉城，告于天地宗廟。
units.en: Empress Jia forged an edict that stripped the empress dowager of her title, confined her in the Jinyong fortress, and had the act proclaimed to Heaven, Earth, and the imperial shrines.
units.literal: Empress Jia forged an edict deposing the empress dowager to commoner status, transferring her to the Jinyong Fortress, and reported it to Heaven, Earth, and the ancestral temples.

units.zh: 誅太后母龐氏。
units.en: The dowager’s mother, Lady Pang, was executed.
units.literal: The empress dowager’s mother, the Lady Pang, was executed.

units.zh: 壬寅，徵大司馬、汝南王亮爲太宰，與太保衛瓘輔政。
units.en: Prince Liang of Runan was recalled from the grand marshal’s post to serve as grand steward alongside Grand Guardian Wei Guan as coregent.
units.literal: On the renyin day, Grand Marshal, Prince Liang of Runan, was summoned to be grand steward, and together with Grand Guardian Wei Guan assisted the government.

units.zh: 以秦王柬爲大將軍，東平王楙爲撫軍大將軍，鎮南將軍、楚王瑋爲衛將軍，領北軍中候，下邳王晃爲尚書令，東安公繇爲尚書左僕射，進封東安王。
units.en: Prince Jian of Qin took the supreme military command; Prince Mao of Dongping became general who soothes the army; Prince Wei of Chu became general of the guards and colonel of the northern camp; Prince Huang of Xiapi headed the secretariat; Duke Yao of Dong’an became its senior deputy and was raised to prince of Dong’an.
units.literal: Prince Jian of Qin was made general-in-chief; Prince Mao of Dongping was made general-in-chief who soothes the army; General Who Guards the South, Prince Wei of Chu, was made general of the guards, heading the colonel of the northern armies; Prince Huang of Xiapi was made director of the secretariat; Duke Yao of Dong’an was made left vice director of the secretariat and advanced in enfeoffment to prince of Dong’an.

units.zh: 督將侯者千八十一人。
units.en: One thousand eighty-one officers of commander rank or above were ennobled as marquises.
units.literal: Supervisors and generals who were marquises numbered one thousand eighty-one persons.

units.zh: 庚戌，免東安王繇及東平王楙，繇徙帶方。
units.en: Princes Yao and Mao were stripped of their posts, and Yao was banished to Daifang on the Korean frontier.
units.literal: On the gengxu day, Prince Yao of Dong’an and Prince Mao of Dongping were dismissed from office; Yao was transferred to Daifang.

units.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以征東將軍、梁王肜爲征西大將軍、都督關西諸軍事，太子少傅阮坦爲平東將軍、監青徐二州諸軍事。
units.en: Prince Rong of Liang was shifted from the eastern to the western theater as area commander beyond the passes, while Ruan Tan was sent to pacify the east and oversee the armies of Qing and Xu.
units.literal: In summer, in the fourth month, on the guihai day, General Who Conquers the East, Prince Xiong of Liang, was made general-in-chief who conquers the west and area commander for all military affairs west of the passes; Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent Ruan Tan was made general who pacifies the east and overseer of military affairs in Qing and Xu provinces.

units.zh: 己巳，以太子太傅王戎爲尚書右僕射。
units.en: Wang Rong moved from tutoring the heir apparent to the right vice directorship of the secretariat.
units.literal: On the jisi day, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent Wang Rong was made right vice director of the secretariat.

units.zh: 五月甲戌[2]，毗陵王軌薨。
units.en: Prince Gui of Piling died in the fifth month [2].
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiaxu day [2], Prince Gui of Piling died.

units.zh: 壬午，除天下戶調綿絹，賜孝悌、高年、鰥寡、力田者帛，人三匹。
units.en: The silk portion of the poll tax was remitted nationwide, and three bolts of silk went to each exemplar of filial piety, each venerable elder, each solitary widower or widow, and each diligent farmer.
units.literal: On the renwu day, household silk levies under Heaven were abolished; filial and fraternal persons, the aged, widowers, widows, and those who labored the fields were granted silk, three bolts per person.

units.zh: 六月，賈后矯詔使楚王瑋殺太宰、汝南王亮，太保、菑陽公衛瓘。
units.en: In the sixth month Empress Jia forged orders that sent Prince Wei of Chu to murder Prince Liang of Runan, the grand steward, and Duke Wei Guan of Ziyang, the grand guardian.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Empress Jia forged an edict causing Prince Wei of Chu to kill Grand Steward, Prince Liang of Runan, and Grand Guardian, Duke Wei Guan of Ziyang.

units.zh: 乙丑，以瑋擅害亮、瓘，殺之。
units.en: On the yichou day Prince Wei was executed for having murdered Liang and Guan without authorization.
units.literal: On the yichou day, because Wei had on his own authority harmed Liang and Guan, he was killed.

units.zh: 曲赦洛陽。
units.en: Luoyang received a limited amnesty.
units.literal: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for Luoyang.

units.zh: 以廣陵王師劉寔爲太子太保，司空、隴西王泰錄尚書事。
units.en: Liu Shi became grand guardian to the crown prince, and Prince Tai of Longxi, still minister of works, took charge of secretariat business.
units.literal: Preceptor to the Prince of Guangling, Liu Shi, was made grand guardian of the heir apparent; Minister of Works, Prince Tai of Longxi, recorded the affairs of the secretariat.

units.zh: 秋七月，分揚州、荊州十郡爲江州。
units.en: Ten commanderies split from Yang and Jing were formed into a new Jiang Province.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, ten commanderies from Yang and Jing provinces were partitioned off as Jiang Province.

units.zh: 八月庚申，以趙王倫爲征東將軍、都督徐兗二州諸軍事；
units.en: Prince Lun of Zhao was named general who conquers the east and given joint command over Xu and Yan;
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the gengshen day, Prince Lun of Zhao was made general who conquers the east and area commander for military affairs in Xu and Yan provinces;

units.zh: 河間王顒爲北中郎將，鎮鄴；
units.en: Prince Yong of Hejian became a northern camp general and garrisoned Ye;
units.literal: Prince Yong of Hejian was made general of the northern gentlemen of the household and stationed at Ye;

units.zh: 太子太師何劭爲都督豫州諸軍事，鎮許昌。
units.en: He Shao, the heir apparent’s grand preceptor, took command in Yu Province from a base at Xuchang.
units.literal: Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent He Shao was made area commander for military affairs in Yu Province and stationed at Xuchang.

units.zh: 徙長沙王乂爲常山王。
units.en: Prince Yi of Changsha was re-enfeoffed as prince of Changshan.
units.literal: Prince Yi of Changsha was transferred to be prince of Changshan.

units.zh: 己巳，進西陽公羕爵爲王。
units.en: Duke Yang of Xiyang was raised to princely rank.
units.literal: On the jisi day, Duke Yang of Xiyang was advanced in noble rank to prince.

units.zh: 辛未，立隴西世子越爲東海王。
units.en: Yue, heir of the house of Longxi, was created prince of Donghai.
units.literal: On the xinwei day, heir apparent Yue of Longxi was established as prince of Donghai.

units.zh: 九月甲午，大將軍、秦王柬薨。
units.en: On jiawu in the ninth month, Sima Jian, Prince of Qin and Great General, died.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on jiawu, Jian, Prince of Qin and Great General, died.

units.zh: 辛丑，徵征西大將軍、梁王肜爲衛將軍、錄尚書事，以趙王倫爲征西大將軍、都督雍梁二州諸軍事。
units.en: On xinchou, Sima Rong, Prince of Liang and Great General Who Conquers the West, was recalled as General of the Guards and manager of Secretariat affairs. Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, became Great General Who Conquers the West and commander of military affairs in Yong and Liang provinces.
units.literal: On xinchou, Rong, Prince of Liang and Great General Who Conquers the West, was summoned to be General of the Guards and manager of Secretariat affairs; Lun, Prince of Zhao, was made Great General Who Conquers the West and commander-in-chief of military affairs in Yong and Liang provinces.

units.zh: 冬十二月辛酉，京師地震。
units.en: The capital shook in an earthquake in the twelfth month.
units.literal: In winter, the twelfth month, on the xinyou day, there was an earthquake in the capital region.

units.zh: 是歲，東夷十七國、南夷二十四部並詣校尉內附。
units.en: Seventeen eastern barbarian states and twenty-four southern tribes presented themselves to the frontier colonels and asked to submit.
units.literal: That year, seventeen states of the eastern Yi and twenty-four tribes of the southern Yi all came to the colonel and submitted internally.

units.zh: 二年春二月己酉，賈后弒皇太后于金墉城。
units.en: In the second lunar month of the second year Empress Jia had the empress dowager killed inside the Jinyong fortress.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, second month, on the jiyou day, Empress Jia murdered the empress dowager at the Jinyong Fortress.

units.zh: 秋八月壬子，大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed in the eighth month.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, on the renzi day, a general amnesty.

units.zh: 九月乙酉，中山王耽薨。
units.en: Prince Dan of Zhongshan died in the ninth month.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the yiyou day, Prince Dan of Zhongshan died.

units.zh: 冬十一月，大疫。
units.en: A severe epidemic struck in the eleventh month.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, a great pestilence.

units.zh: 是歲，沛國雨雹，傷麥。
units.en: Hailstorms in Pei damaged the wheat crop that year.
units.literal: That year, in Pei commandery it rained hail, injuring wheat.

units.zh: 三年夏四月，滎陽雨雹。
units.en: In the fourth month of the third year hail fell on Xingyang.
units.literal: In the third year, summer, fourth month, in Xingyang it rained hail.

units.zh: 六月，弘農郡雨雹，深三尺。
units.en: Hongnong was struck by hail that piled three feet deep in the sixth month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, in Hongnong commandery it rained hail, three chi deep.

units.zh: 冬十月，太原王泓薨。
units.en: Prince Hong of Taiyuan died in the tenth month.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Prince Hong of Taiyuan died.

units.zh: 四年春正月丁酉朔，侍中、太尉、安昌公石鑒薨。
units.en: On New Year’s Day of the fourth year Duke Shi Jian of Anchang, who was palace attendant and grand commandant, died.
units.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the dingyou new moon, Palace Attendant, Grand Commandant, Duke Shi Jian of Anchang died.

units.zh: 夏五月，蜀郡山移，淮南壽春洪水出，山崩地陷，壞城府及百姓廬舍。
units.en: In the fifth month landslides rearranged hills in Shu, while Shouchun in Huainan flooded as the ground gave way, ruining walls and homes.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, in Shu commandery mountains shifted; in Shouchun in Huainan flood waters emerged; mountains collapsed and earth subsided, destroying city walls and commoners’ huts.

units.zh: 匈奴郝散反，攻上黨，殺長吏。
units.en: The Xiongnu leader Hao San rose in revolt, struck Shangdang, and slew the ranking officials there.
units.literal: The Xiongnu Hao San rebelled, attacked Shangdang, and killed senior officials.

units.zh: 六月，壽春地大震，死者二十餘家。
units.en: A violent earthquake at Shouchun in the sixth month killed more than twenty families.
units.literal: In the sixth month, in Shouchun the earth greatly quaked; more than twenty households died.

units.zh: 上庸郡山崩，殺二十餘人。
units.en: A mountain slide in Shangyong claimed more than twenty lives.
units.literal: In Shangyong commandery a mountain collapsed, killing more than twenty persons.

units.zh: 秋八月，郝散帥眾降，馮翊都尉殺之。
units.en: Hao San surrendered with his followers in the eighth month, whereupon the Fengyi commandery captain had him killed.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Hao San led his host in surrender; the commandery captain of Fengyi killed him.

units.zh: 上谷居庸、上庸並地陷裂，水泉涌出，人有死者。
units.en: The ground split open at Juyong in Shanggu and in Shangyong commandery, geysers burst through the fissures, and people were killed.
units.literal: Juyong in Shanggu and Shangyong together had earth sink and split; water springs gushed forth; there were persons who died.

units.zh: 大饑。
units.en: Famine spread across the realm.
units.literal: Great famine.

units.zh: 九月丙辰，赦諸州之遭地災者。
units.en: On the bingchen day in the ninth month, amnesty was extended to every province hit by the earthquakes.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on the bingchen day, the various provinces that had suffered earth disasters were amnestied.

units.zh: 甲午，枉矢東北竟天。
units.en: A “crooked-arrow” comet streaked across the northeastern sky from horizon to horizon on the jiawu day.
units.literal: On the jiawu day, a crooked arrow meteor in the northeast filled the sky.

units.zh: 是歲，京師及郡國八地震。
units.en: The capital and eight commanderies reported earthquakes that year.
units.literal: That year, the capital region and eight commanderies and kingdoms had earthquakes.

units.zh: 五年夏四月，彗星見于西方，孛于奎，至軒轅。
units.en: In the fourth month of the fifth year a comet blazed in the west from the Kui asterism toward Xuanyuan.
units.literal: In the fifth year, summer, fourth month, a broom star appeared in the west, broom-liked in Kui, reaching to Xuanyuan.

units.zh: 六月，金城地震。
units.en: Jincheng was shaken by an earthquake in the sixth month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, there was an earthquake in Jincheng.

units.zh: 東海雨雹，深五寸。
units.en: Hail in Donghai piled five inches deep.
units.literal: In Donghai it rained hail, five cun deep.

units.zh: 秋七月，下邳暴風，壞廬舍。
units.en: A violent windstorm in Xiapi tore down houses in the seventh month.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, in Xiapi a violent wind destroyed huts.

units.zh: 九月，雁門、新興、太原、上黨大風，傷禾稼。
units.en: Gales across Yanmen, Xinxing, Taiyuan, and Shangdang in the ninth month flattened the standing grain.
units.literal: In the ninth month, in Yanmen, Xinxing, Taiyuan, and Shangdang great wind, injuring grain crops.

units.zh: 冬十月，武庫火，焚累代之寶。
units.en: Fire consumed the imperial armory in the tenth month, destroying heirlooms gathered over many reigns.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the armory caught fire and burned treasures accumulated through generations.

units.zh: 十二月丙戌，新作武庫，大調兵器。
units.en: On the bingxu day in the twelfth month work began on a new armory and a major requisition of weapons was ordered.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingxu day, a new armory was constructed; weapons were greatly mobilized.

units.zh: 丹楊雨雹。
units.en: Hailstorms struck Danyang.
units.literal: In Danyang it rained hail.

units.zh: 有石生于京師宜年里。
units.en: A stone was said to have “sprouted” in Yinian ward inside the capital.
units.literal: There was a stone that grew in Yinian Ward in the capital.

units.zh: 是歲，荊、揚、兗、豫、青、徐等六州大水，詔遣御史巡行振貸。
units.en: Great floods inundated six provinces—Jing, Yang, Yan, Yu, Qing, and Xu—and the court sent censors on circuit with grain loans for relief.
units.literal: That year, Jing, Yang, Yan, Yu, Qing, Xu and so on—six provinces—great flood; an edict dispatched censors to tour and relieve with loans.

units.zh: 六年春正月，大赦。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: In spring, in the first month of the sixth year, there was a great amnesty.

units.zh: 司空、下邳王晃薨。
units.en: Sima Huang, Prince of Xiapi and Minister of Works, died.
units.literal: Huang, Prince of Xiapi and Minister of Works, died.

units.zh: 以中書監張華爲司空，太尉、隴西王泰爲尚書令，衛將軍、梁王肜爲太子太保。
units.en: Zhang Hua, Director of the Secretariat, was appointed Minister of Works; Sima Tai, Prince of Longxi and Grand Commandant, became Director of the Secretariat; and Sima Rong, Prince of Liang and General of the Guards, became Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.
units.literal: Zhang Hua, Director of the Secretariat, was made Minister of Works; Tai, Prince of Longxi and Grand Commandant, was made Director of the Secretariat; Rong, Prince of Liang and General of the Guards, was made Grand Guardian of the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 丁丑，地震。
units.en: On dingchou, an earthquake occurred.
units.literal: On dingchou, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 三月，東海隕霜，傷桑麥。
units.en: Late frost in Donghai in the third month damaged the mulberries and wheat.
units.literal: In the third month, in Donghai frost fell, injuring mulberry and wheat.

units.zh: 彭城呂縣有流血，東西百餘步。
units.en: Blood is said to have flowed from the ground for over a hundred paces east to west in Lü county, Pengcheng.
units.literal: In Lü county of Pengcheng there was flowing blood, east to west more than one hundred bu.

units.zh: 夏四月，大風。
units.en: High winds swept the realm in the fourth month of summer.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, there were great winds.

units.zh: 五月，荊、揚二州大水。
units.en: Jing and Yang provinces were overwhelmed by flood in the fifth month.
units.literal: In the fifth month, Jing and Yang provinces suffered great flooding.

units.zh: 匈奴郝散弟度元帥馮翊、北地馬蘭羌、盧水胡反，攻北地，太守張損死之。
units.en: Du Yuan, Hao San’s brother, led Qiang and Lushui Hu allies from Fengyi and Beidi in revolt, stormed Beidi, and killed Prefect Zhang Sun in the fighting.
units.literal: Hao San’s younger brother of the Xiongnu, Du Yuan, led the Fengyi, Beidi Malan Qiang, and Lushui Hu in rebellion, attacked Beidi, and Prefect Zhang Sun died in it.

units.zh: 馮翊太守歐陽建與度元戰，建敗績。
units.en: Ouyang Jian, prefect of Fengyi, met Du Yuan in battle and suffered a rout.
units.literal: Fengyi Prefect Ouyang Jian battled with Du Yuan; Jian was defeated.

units.zh: 徵征西大將軍、趙王倫爲車騎將軍，以太子太保、梁王肜爲征西大將軍、都督雍梁二州諸軍事，鎮關中。
units.en: Prince Lun of Zhao was recalled from the western command to the capital post of general of chariots and cavalry, while Prince Rong of Liang took his place as general-in-chief in the west with authority over Yong and Liang and a mandate to hold the Guanzhong frontier.
units.literal: General-in-chief who conquers the west, Prince Lun of Zhao, was summoned to be general of chariots and cavalry; Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Prince Rong of Liang, was made general-in-chief who conquers the west and area commander for military affairs in Yong and Liang provinces, garrisoning within the passes.

units.zh: 秋八月，雍州刺史解系又爲度元所破。
units.en: Inspector Xie Xi of Yong Province was defeated again by Du Yuan in the eighth month.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Yong Province Inspector Xie Xi was again by Du Yuan defeated.

units.zh: 秦雍氐、羌悉叛，推氐帥齊萬年僭號稱帝，圍涇陽。
units.en: Di and Qiang across Qin and Yong rose as one, acclaimed Qi Wannian as emperor, and laid siege to Jingyang.
units.literal: Qin and Yong Di and Qiang all rebelled, raised Di leader Qi Wannian to usurp a title and declare himself emperor, and besieged Jingyang.

units.zh: 冬十月乙未，曲赦雍、涼二州。
units.en: Yong and Liang received a limited amnesty on the yiwei day in the tenth month.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the yiwei day, a partial amnesty for Yong and Liang two provinces.

units.zh: 十一月丙子，遣安西將軍夏侯駿、建威將軍周處等討萬年，梁王肜屯好畤。
units.en: Xiahou Jun and Zhou Chu were sent against Qi Wannian in the eleventh month while Prince Rong of Liang held a supporting camp at Haozhi.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the bingzi day, General Who Pacifies the West Xiahou Jun, General Who Establishes Might Zhou Chu, and others were dispatched to attack Wannian; Prince Rong of Liang encamped at Haozhi.

units.zh: 關中饑，大疫。
units.en: Famine and plague ravaged the Guanzhong heartland.
units.literal: Within the passes there was famine and great pestilence.

units.zh: 七年春正月癸丑，周處及齊萬年戰於六陌，王師敗績，處死之。
units.en: Zhou Chu fell fighting Qi Wannian at Liumo in the first month of the seventh year when the imperial army was routed.
units.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the guichou day, Zhou Chu and Qi Wannian battled at Liumo; the royal army was defeated; Chu died in it.

units.zh: 夏五月，魯國雨雹。
units.en: Hailstorms struck the Lu princedom in the fifth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, in the Lu state it rained hail.

units.zh: 秋七月，雍、梁州疫。
units.en: Plague broke out in Yong and Liang in the seventh month.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, there was pestilence in Yong and Liang provinces.

units.zh: 大旱，隕霜，殺秋稼。
units.en: Drought and untimely frost wiped out the autumn harvest.
units.literal: Great drought; falling frost; killed autumn crops.

units.zh: 關中饑，米斛萬錢。
units.en: In the starving Guanzhong heartland a bushel of grain cost ten thousand cash.
units.literal: Within the passes famine; rice one hu ten thousand cash.

units.zh: 詔骨肉相賣者不禁。
units.en: An edict lifted the ban on kin selling one another to survive.
units.literal: An edict: bone-flesh mutually selling was not forbidden.

units.zh: 丁丑，司徒、京陵公王渾薨。
units.en: Duke Wang Hun of Jingling, the minister of education, died on the dingchou day.
units.literal: On the dingchou day, Minister of Education, Duke Wang Hun of Jingling died.

units.zh: 九月，以尚書右僕射王戎爲司徒，太子太師何劭爲尚書左僕射。
units.en: Wang Rong advanced from right vice director to minister of education, and He Shao from the heir apparent’s grand preceptor to left vice director of the secretariat in the ninth month.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Rong was made minister of education; Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent He Shao was made left vice director of the secretariat.

units.zh: 八年春正月丙辰，地震。
units.en: The earth shook on the bingchen day in the first month of the eighth year.
units.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on the bingchen day, there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 詔發倉廩，振雍州饑人。
units.en: The court ordered state granaries opened to feed the starving population of Yong Province.
units.literal: An edict ordered the opening of granaries and relief for the starving people of Yong Province.

units.zh: 三月壬戌，大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed on the renxu day in the third month.
units.literal: In the third month, on the renxu day, a general amnesty.

units.zh: 夏五月，郊禖石破爲二。
units.en: In the fifth month the sacred stone at the suburban altar to the progenitor-god cracked clean in two.
units.literal: In summer, the fifth month, the suburban prayer-for-heirs stone split into two.

units.zh: 秋九月，荊、豫、揚、徐、冀等五州大水。
units.en: Massive floods inundated the five provinces of Jing, Yu, Yang, Xu, and Ji in the ninth month.
units.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, Jing, Yu, Yang, Xu, Ji, and so on—five provinces—great flood.

units.zh: 雍州有年。
units.en: Yong Province alone enjoyed a good harvest that year.
units.literal: Yong Province had a harvest year.

units.zh: 九年春正月，左積弩將軍孟觀伐氐，戰于中亭，大破之，獲齊萬年。
units.en: In the first month of the ninth year Meng Guan, general of the left strong crossbow corps, struck the Di at Zhongting, shattered their host, and took Qi Wannian alive.
units.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, General of the Left Strong Crossbow Meng Guan attacked the Di, battled at Zhongting, greatly defeated them, and captured Qi Wannian.

units.zh: 徵征西大將軍、梁王肜錄尚書事。
units.en: Prince Rong of Liang, general-in-chief who conquers the west, was summoned to take charge of secretariat affairs.
units.literal: General-in-chief who conquers the west, Prince Xiong of Liang, was summoned to record the affairs of the secretariat.

units.zh: 以北中郎將、河間王顒爲鎮西將軍，鎮關中；
units.en: Prince Yong of Hejian was promoted from northern camp general to general who guards the west and ordered to hold the Guanzhong frontier;
units.literal: General of the Northern Gentlemen of the Household, Prince Yong of Hejian, was made general who guards the west and garrisoned within the passes;

units.zh: 成都王穎爲鎮北大將軍，鎮鄴。
units.en: Prince Ying of Chengdu received the northern supreme command and took up headquarters at Ye.
units.literal: Prince Ying of Chengdu was made general-in-chief who guards the north and garrisoned at Ye.

units.zh: 夏四月，鄴人張承基等妖言署置，聚黨數千。
units.en: In the fourth month Zhang Chengji of Ye and his confederates spread seditious prophecies, set up a bogus administration, and rallied several thousand followers.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Ye men Zhang Chengji and others with demonic words set up appointments and gathered a faction of several thousand.

units.zh: 郡縣逮捕，皆伏誅。
units.en: County and prefectural officers rounded them up, and every ringleader went to the block.
units.literal: The commanderies and counties arrested them; all were executed.

units.zh: 六月戊戌，太尉、隴西王泰薨。
units.en: Prince Tai of Longxi, the grand commandant, died on the wuxu day in the sixth month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuxu day, Grand Commandant, Prince Tai of Longxi, died.

units.zh: 秋八月，以尚書裴頠爲尚書僕射。
units.en: In the eighth month Pei Wei advanced from ordinary minister to vice director of the secretariat.
units.literal: In autumn, the eighth month, Minister Pei Wei was made vice director of the secretariat.

units.zh: 冬十一月甲子朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: A solar eclipse darkened the sky on the new moon of the eleventh month.
units.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the jiazi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 京師大風，發屋折木。
units.en: A violent gale struck the capital, ripping roofs away and snapping trees.
units.literal: In the capital region great wind; it tore off roofs and broke trees.

units.zh: 十二月壬戌，廢皇太子遹爲庶人，及其三子幽于金墉城，殺太子母謝氏。
units.en: On the renxu day in the twelfth month Crown Prince Sima Yu was stripped of his title and imprisoned with his three sons in the Jinyong fortress, while his mother Lady Xie was put to death.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the renxu day, Crown Prince You was deposed to commoner status; together with his three sons he was confined in the Jinyong Fortress; the crown prince’s mother, the Lady Xie, was killed.

units.zh: 永康元年春正月癸亥朔，大赦，改元。
units.en: The new moon of the first month of Yongkang brought a general amnesty and a new reign title.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, spring, first month, on the guihai new moon, a general amnesty; the era name was changed.

units.zh: 己卯，日有蝕之。
units.en: The sun was eclipsed on the jimao day.
units.literal: On the jimao day, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 丙子，皇孫𧇃卒。
units.en: On the bingzi day the imperial grandson died.
units.literal: On the bingzi day, the imperial grandson 𧇃 died.

units.zh: 二月丁酉，大風，飛沙拔木。
units.en: A sand-laden gale uprooted timber on the dingyou day in the second month.
units.literal: In the second month, on the dingyou day, great wind; flying sand uprooted trees.

units.zh: 三月，尉氏雨血，妖星見于南方。
units.en: Weishi was said to have been drenched in blood-red rain, and an ominous star shone in the southern sky.
units.literal: In the third month, in Weishi it rained blood; a prodigy star appeared in the south.

units.zh: 癸未，賈后矯詔害庶人遹于許昌。
units.en: On the guiwei day Empress Jia used forged orders to murder the deposed heir Sima You at Xuchang.
units.literal: On the guiwei day, Empress Jia forged an edict and harmed the commoner You at Xuchang.

units.zh: 夏四月辛卯，日有蝕之。
units.en: Another solar eclipse occurred on the xinmao day in the fourth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the xinmao day, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 癸巳，梁王肜、趙王倫矯詔廢賈后爲庶人，司空張華、尚書僕射裴頠皆遇害，侍中賈謐及黨與數十人皆伏誅。
units.en: On the guisi day Princes Xiong and Lun forged an edict that deposed Empress Jia; Zhang Hua and Pei Wei were killed, and Jia Mi with dozens of his partisans went to the execution ground.
units.literal: On the guisi day, Prince Xiong of Liang and Prince Lun of Zhao forged an edict deposing Empress Jia to commoner status; Minister of Works Zhang Hua and Vice Director of the Secretariat Pei Wei both met harm and died; Palace Attendant Jia Mi and several tens of his faction were all executed.

units.zh: 甲午，倫矯詔大赦，自爲相國、都督中外諸軍，如宣文輔魏故事，追復故皇太子位。
units.en: The next day Prince Lun forged a general amnesty, named himself chancellor and commander-in-chief on the model of Sima Yi and Sima Zhao, and posthumously reinstated the murdered crown prince.
units.literal: On the jiawu day, Lun forged an edict for a general amnesty, made himself chancellor of state and area commander for all military affairs within and without, according to the old precedent of Xuan and Wen assisting Wei, and posthumously restored the former crown prince’s position.

units.zh: 丁酉，以梁王肜爲太宰，左光祿大夫何劭爲司徒，右光祿大夫劉寔爲司空，淮南王允爲驃騎將軍。
units.en: Prince Xiong became grand steward, He Shao minister of education, Liu Shi minister of works, and Prince Yun of Huainan general of agile cavalry on the dingyou day.
units.literal: On the dingyou day, Prince Xiong of Liang was made grand steward; Left Household Grandee He Shao was made minister of education; Right Household Grandee Liu Shi was made minister of works; Prince Yun of Huainan was made general of agile cavalry.

units.zh: 己亥，趙王倫矯詔害賈庶人于金墉城。
units.en: On the jihai day Prince Lun had the deposed Empress Jia killed inside the Jinyong fortress.
units.literal: On the jihai day, Prince Lun of Zhao forged an edict and harmed the commoner Jia at the Jinyong Fortress.

units.zh: 五月己巳，立皇孫臧爲皇太孫，尚爲襄陽王。
units.en: Sima Zang was named heir apparent’s son and successor, while his brother Shang was created prince of Xiangyang, on the jisi day in the fifth month.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the jisi day, Imperial Grandson Zang was established as imperial grandson-heir; Shang was made prince of Xiangyang.

units.zh: 六月壬寅，葬愍懷太子于顯平陵。
units.en: Crown Prince You, posthumously titled the Lamented Heir, was laid to rest at Xianping mausoleum on the renyin day.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the renyin day, the Lamented Heir Apparent was buried at Xianping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 撫軍將軍、清河王遐薨。
units.en: Prince Xia of Qinghe, who held the title general who soothes the army, died.
units.literal: General Who Soothes the Army, Prince Xia of Qinghe, died.

units.zh: 癸卯，震崇陽陵標。
units.en: Lightning shattered the stele at Emperor Wu’s Chongyang mausoleum on the guimao day.
units.literal: On the guimao day, Chongyang Mausoleum’s marker was struck by lightning.

units.zh: 秋八月，淮南王允舉兵討趙王倫，不克，允及其二子秦王郁、漢王迪皆遇害。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, Sima Yun, Prince of Huainan, raised troops against Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, but failed. Yun and his sons Yu, Prince of Qin, and Di, Prince of Han, were all killed.
units.literal: In autumn, in the eighth month, Yun, Prince of Huainan, raised troops to attack Lun, Prince of Zhao, but could not succeed; Yun and his two sons, Yu, Prince of Qin, and Di, Prince of Han, were all killed.

units.zh: 曲赦洛陽。
units.en: A special pardon was granted in Luoyang.
units.literal: A special pardon was issued for Luoyang.

units.zh: 平東將軍、彭城王植薨。
units.en: Sima Zhi, Prince of Pengcheng and General Who Pacifies the East, died.
units.literal: Zhi, Prince of Pengcheng and General Who Pacifies the East, died.

units.zh: 改封吳王晏爲賓徒縣王。
units.en: Sima Yan, Prince of Wu, was redesignated Prince of Bintu county.
units.literal: Yan, Prince of Wu, was reassigned as Prince of Bintu county.

units.zh: 以齊王冏爲平東將軍，鎮許昌；
units.en: Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi, was appointed General Who Pacifies the East and stationed at Xuchang;
units.literal: Jiong, Prince of Qi, was made General Who Pacifies the East and stationed at Xuchang;

units.zh: 光祿大夫陳準爲太尉、錄尚書事。
units.en: Chen Zhun, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, became Grand Commandant and manager of Secretariat affairs.
units.literal: Chen Zhun, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, was made Grand Commandant and manager of Secretariat affairs.

units.zh: 九月，改司徒爲丞相，以梁王肜爲之。
units.en: The ninth month saw the office of minister of education renamed chancellor, with Prince Xiong of Liang appointed to the post.
units.literal: In the ninth month, minister of education was changed to chancellor of state; Prince Xiong of Liang was made such.

units.zh: 冬十月，黃霧四塞。
units.en: Yellow fog blanketed the landscape for days that tenth month.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, yellow fog blocked in on four sides.

units.zh: 十一月戊午，大風飛沙石，六日乃止。
units.en: From the wuwu day a six-day sandstorm drove grit through the air until it finally lifted.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on the wuwu day, great wind flew sand and stones; only after six days did it stop.

units.zh: 甲子，立皇后羊氏，大赦，大酺三日。
units.en: Lady Yang was enthroned as empress on the jiazi day, the realm was amnestied, and the court ordered three days of public celebration.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, Lady Yang was established as empress; a general amnesty; great feasting for three days.

units.zh: 十二月，彗星見于東方。
units.en: A comet blazed in the eastern sky during the twelfth month.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, a broom star appeared in the east.

units.zh: 益州刺史趙廞與略陽流人李庠害成都內史耿勝、犍爲太守李密、汶山太守霍固、西夷校尉陳總，據成都反。
units.en: Zhao Xin, the Yi inspector, joined the displaced leader Li Kuang in murdering Geng Sheng and the other local officials, then seized Chengdu and rose in revolt.
units.literal: Inspector of Yi Province Zhao Xin, together with Lüeyang migrant Li Kuang, killed Chengdu Administrator Geng Sheng, Qianwei Prefect Li Mi, Wenshan Prefect Huo Gu, and Colonel of the Western Yi Chen Zong, seized Chengdu, and rebelled.

units.zh: 永寧元年春正月乙丑，趙王倫篡帝位。
units.en: On the yichou day in the first month of Yongning, Prince Lun of Zhao seized the throne.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongning, spring, first month, on the yichou day, Prince Lun of Zhao usurped the imperial throne.

units.zh: 丙寅，遷帝于金墉城，號曰太上皇，改金墉曰永昌宮。
units.en: The next day the true emperor was bundled off to the Jinyong fortress as a nominal “supreme emperor,” and the compound was renamed Yongchang Palace.
units.literal: On the bingyin day, the emperor was moved to the Jinyong Fortress, titled supreme emperor; Jinyong was changed to Yongchang Palace.

units.zh: 廢皇太孫臧爲濮陽王。
units.en: The heir’s son Sima Zang was demoted to prince of Puyang.
units.literal: The imperial grandson-heir Zang was deposed to be prince of Puyang.

units.zh: 五星經天，縱橫無常。
units.en: All five naked-eye planets were seen wheeling across the daytime sky in disorderly paths.
units.literal: The five planets crossed the sky, vertically and horizontally without constancy.

units.zh: 癸酉，倫害濮陽王臧。
units.en: Prince Lun had Sima Zang, now prince of Puyang, murdered on the guiyou day.
units.literal: On the guiyou day, Lun killed Prince Zang of Puyang.

units.zh: 略陽流人李特殺趙廞，傳首京師。
units.en: The refugee leader Li Te slew Zhao Xin and forwarded his head to Luoyang.
units.literal: Lüeyang migrant Li Te killed Zhao Xin and sent his head to the capital.

units.zh: 三月，平東將軍、齊王冏起兵以討倫，傳檄州郡，屯于陽翟。
units.en: In the third month Prince Jiong of Qi, general who pacifies the east, mobilized against Prince Lun, circulated a call to arms through every province, and camped at Yangzhai.
units.literal: In the third month, General Who Pacifies the East, Prince Jiong of Qi, raised troops to attack Lun, transmitted proclamations to the provinces and commanderies, and encamped at Yangzhai.

units.zh: 征北大將軍、成都王穎，征西大將軍、河間王顒，常山王乂，豫州刺史李毅，兗州刺史王彥，南中郎將、新野公歆，皆舉兵應之，眾數十萬。
units.en: Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu and Grand General Who Campaigns North; Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian and Grand General Who Campaigns West; Sima Yi, Prince of Changshan; Li Yi, inspector of Yu Province; Wang Yan, inspector of Yan Province; and Xin, Duke of Xinye and General of the Southern Gentlemen-of-the-Household, all raised armies in response, mustering several hundred thousand men.
units.literal: General-in-chief who conquers the north, Prince Ying of Chengdu; general-in-chief who conquers the west, Prince Yong of Hejian; Prince Yi of Changshan; Inspector of Yu Province Li Yi; Inspector of Yan Province Wang Yan; General of the Southern Gentlemen of the Household, Duke Xin of Xinye—all raised troops in response; the hosts numbered several hundred thousand.

units.zh: 倫遣其將閭和出伊闕，張泓、孫輔出堮阪以距冏，孫會、士猗、許超出黃橋以距穎。
units.en: Prince Lun sent Lü He through the Yique pass, Zhang Hong and Sun Fu over the E ridge to block Prince Jiong, and Sun Hui, Shi Yi, and Xu Chao from Huang Bridge to stop Prince Ying.
units.literal: Lun dispatched his generals Lü He out of Yique, Zhang Hong and Sun Fu out of E Slope to resist Jiong, and Sun Hui, Shi Yi, and Xu Chao out of Huang Bridge to resist Ying.

units.zh: 及穎將趙驤、石超戰于湨水，會等大敗，棄軍走。
units.en: At the Ju River, Zhao Xiang and Shi Chao, serving Prince Ying, routed Sun Hui’s army, which broke and ran.
units.literal: When Ying’s generals Zhao Xiang and Shi Chao battled at the Ju River, Hui and the others were greatly defeated and abandoned the army and fled.

units.zh: 閏月丙戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: The intercalary month opened with a solar eclipse on the bingxu new moon.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the bingxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 夏四月，歲星晝見。
units.en: Jupiter shone visible in broad daylight during the fourth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the year star was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 冏將何勖、盧播擊張泓於陽翟，大破之，斬孫輔等。
units.en: He Xu and Lu Bo, under Prince Jiong, crushed Zhang Hong at Yangzhai and executed Sun Fu among others.
units.literal: Jiong’s generals He Xu and Lu Bo attacked Zhang Hong at Yangzhai, greatly defeated him, and beheaded Sun Fu and others.

units.zh: 辛酉，左衛將軍王輿與尚書、淮陵王漼勒兵入宮，禽倫黨孫秀、孫會、許超、士猗、駱休等，皆斬之。
units.en: On the xinyou day Wang Yu and Prince Cui of Huailing forced the palace gates, seized Lun’s confederates Sun Xiu, Sun Hui, Xu Chao, Shi Yi, Luo Xiu, and others, and put them all to the sword.
units.literal: On the xinyou day, General of the Left Guards Wang Yu, together with the minister, Prince Cui of Huailing, led troops into the palace, captured Lun’s faction Sun Xiu, Sun Hui, Xu Chao, Shi Yi, Luo Xiu, and others; all were beheaded.

units.zh: 逐倫歸第，即日乘輿反正。
units.en: Prince Lun was sent home under guard, and the emperor was restored to the throne that same day.
units.literal: They expelled Lun to return to his residence; that same day the imperial carriage returned to rectitude.

units.zh: 群臣頓首謝罪，帝曰：「非諸卿之過也。」
units.en: The ministers prostrated themselves in apology, but the emperor told them, “None of this was your doing.”
units.literal: The host of ministers knocked their heads in admitting guilt; the emperor said, “It is not the fault of you various ministers.”

units.zh: 癸亥，詔曰：「朕以不德，纂承皇統，遠不能光濟大業，靖綏四方；
units.en: On the guihai day an edict began: “Lacking virtue, I yet inherited the throne, and I have not been able to extend the great enterprise or bring peace to the four quarters of the realm;
units.literal: On the guihai day, an edict stated: “I, lacking virtue, have succeeded to the imperial line; afar I have been unable to brighten and aid the great enterprise and pacify and soothe the four directions;

units.zh: 近不能開明刑威，式遏姦宄，至使逆臣孫秀敢肆凶虐，窺間王室，遂奉趙王倫饕據天位。
units.en: Near at hand I failed to make law and majesty clear enough to stop treason, so the rebel Sun Xiu could brutalize the court, tear at the royal house, and help Prince Lun of Zhao seize the throne by force.
units.literal: Near I have been unable to open and clarify punishments and might and check villainy and treachery, so that the rebellious minister Sun Xiu dared unleash cruelty and violence, spy on and divide the royal house, and thereupon supporting Prince Lun of Zhao greedily seized the heavenly position.

units.zh: 鎮東大將軍、齊王冏，征北大將軍、成都王穎，征西大將軍、河間王顒，並以明德茂親，忠規允著，首建大策，匡救國難。
units.en: General-in-chief who guards the east Prince Jiong of Qi, general-in-chief who conquers the north Prince Ying of Chengdu, and general-in-chief who conquers the west Prince Yong of Hejian are men of shining virtue and eminent kinship whose loyal counsel stood the test; they first devised the great plan that delivered the state from disaster.
units.literal: General-in-chief who guards the east, Prince Jiong of Qi; general-in-chief who conquers the north, Prince Ying of Chengdu; general-in-chief who conquers the west, Prince Yong of Hejian—all with bright virtue as flourishing kin, loyal plans truly manifest, first established the great strategy and rectified and saved the state’s crisis.

units.zh: 尚書漼共立大謀，左衛將軍王輿與群公卿士，協同謀略，親勒本營，斬秀及其二子。
units.en: Minister Cui framed the decisive plot; Wang Yu, general of the left guards, with the high ministers acting in concert, led their household troops into the palace and slew Sun Xiu together with his two sons.
units.literal: Minister Cui together established the great plan; General of the Left Guards Wang Yu, together with the host of dukes, ministers, and gentlemen, coordinated in stratagem, personally commanded the original camp, and beheaded Xiu and his two sons.

units.zh: 前趙王倫爲秀所誤，與其子等已詣金墉迎朕幽宮，旋軫閶闔。
units.en: The former Prince Lun of Zhao was deceived by Sun Xiu; he and his sons had already reached the Jinyong compound to bring me out of confinement and were turning their carriages toward the Changhe Gate.
units.literal: The former Prince Lun of Zhao was misled by Xiu; together with his sons and others he had already gone to Jinyong to welcome me from the hidden palace, turning the carriage at Changhe.

units.zh: 豈在予一人獨饗其慶，宗廟社稷實有賴焉。」
units.en: How could the blessing rest on me alone? The ancestral shrines and the altars of soil and grain have truly depended on them.”
units.literal: How could it be that I alone partake of the blessing? The ancestral temples and altars of soil and grain truly have relied on this.”

units.zh: 於是大赦，改元，孤寡賜穀五斛，大酺五日。
units.en: With the edict closed, the court ordered a general amnesty, a new reign title, five hu of grain for every widow, widower, and orphan, and five days of public feasting.
units.literal: Thereupon a general amnesty; the era name was changed; widowers, widows, and orphans were granted grain, five hu; great feasting for five days.

units.zh: 誅趙王倫、義陽王威、九門侯質等及倫之黨與。
units.en: Prince Lun, Prince Wei of Yiyang, Marquis Zhi of the Nine Gates, and the rest of Lun’s clique were put to death.
units.literal: Prince Lun of Zhao, Prince Wei of Yiyang, Marquis Zhi of Jiumen, and others, and Lun’s factional followers, were executed.

units.zh: 五月，立襄陽王尚爲皇太孫。
units.en: In the fifth month Prince Shang of Xiangyang was named heir to the throne.
units.literal: In the fifth month, Prince Shang of Xiangyang was established as imperial grandson-heir.

units.zh: 六月戊辰，大赦，增吏位二等。
units.en: The wuchen day in the sixth month brought a general amnesty and a two-grade promotion for every official.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuchen day, a general amnesty; officials’ ranks were increased two grades.

units.zh: 復封賓徒王晏爲吳王。
units.en: Prince Yan of Bintu was restored to the old Wu princedom.
units.literal: Prince Yan of Bintu was again enfeoffed as prince of Wu.

units.zh: 庚午，東萊王蕤、左衛將軍王輿謀廢齊王冏，事泄，蕤廢爲庶人，輿伏誅，夷三族。
units.en: Prince Rui of Donglai and Wang Yu conspired to topple Prince Jiong; when the plot surfaced, Rui was reduced to commoner rank while Wang Yu and three degrees of his kin were executed.
units.literal: On the gengwu day, Prince Rui of Donglai and General of the Left Guards Wang Yu plotted to depose Prince Jiong of Qi; the affair leaked; Rui was deposed to commoner status; Yu submitted to execution; three clans were exterminated.

units.zh: 甲戌，以齊王冏爲大司馬、都督中外諸軍事，成都王穎爲大將軍、錄尚書事，河間王顒爲太尉。
units.en: Prince Jiong became grand marshal and commander-in-chief, Prince Ying general-in-chief with charge of the secretariat, and Prince Yong grand commandant on the jiaxu day.
units.literal: On the jiaxu day, Prince Jiong of Qi was made grand marshal and area commander for all military affairs within and without; Prince Ying of Chengdu was made general-in-chief and recorder of secretariat affairs; Prince Yong of Hejian was made grand commandant.

units.zh: 罷丞相，復置司徒官。
units.en: The chancellorship was abolished and the ministry of education revived.
units.literal: The chancellor was abolished; the office of minister of education was re-established.

units.zh: 己卯，以梁王肜爲太宰，領司徒。
units.en: Prince Rong of Liang was named grand steward while retaining the ministry of education on the jimao day.
units.literal: On the jimao day, Prince Xiong of Liang was made grand steward, concurrently heading the ministry of education.

units.zh: 封齊王冏功臣葛旟牟平公，路季小黃公，衛毅平陰公，劉真安鄉公，韓泰封丘公。
units.en: Prince Jiong of Qi's meritorious followers were enfeoffed: Ge Yu as Duke of Mouping, Lu Ji as Duke of Xiaohuang, Wei Yi as Duke of Pingyin, Liu Zhen as Duke of Anxiang, and Han Tai as Duke of Fengqiu.
units.literal: Prince Jiong of Qi’s meritorious subjects Ge Yu was enfeoffed duke of Mouping, Lu Ji duke of Xiaohuang, Wei Yi duke of Pingyin, Liu Zhen duke of Anxiang, and Han Tai duke of Fengqiu.

units.zh: 秋七月甲午，立吳王晏子國爲漢王，復封常山王乂爲長沙王。
units.en: On the jiawu day in the seventh month Sima Guo, son of Prince Yan of Wu, was created prince of Han, and Prince Yi was moved back from Changshan to the Changsha princedom.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the jiawu day, Prince Yan of Wu’s son Guo was established as prince of Han; Prince Yi of Changshan was again enfeoffed as prince of Changsha.

units.zh: 八月，大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was declared in the eighth month.
units.literal: In the eighth month, a general amnesty.

units.zh: 戊辰，原徙邊者。
units.en: Frontier exiles were pardoned on the wuchen day.
units.literal: On the wuchen day, those who had been banished to the frontier were pardoned.

units.zh: 益州刺史羅尚討羌，破之。
units.en: Luo Shang, inspector of Yi, campaigned against the Qiang and broke their host.
units.literal: Inspector of Yi Province Luo Shang attacked the Qiang and defeated them.

units.zh: 己巳，徙南平王祥爲宜都王。
units.en: Prince Xiang of Nanping was reassigned to the Yidu princedom on the jisi day.
units.literal: On the jisi day, Prince Xiang of Nanping was transferred to be prince of Yidu.

units.zh: 下邳王韡薨。
units.en: The prince of Xiapi, Sima Wei, passed away.
units.literal: Prince Wei of Xiapi died.

units.zh: 以東平王楙爲平東將軍、都督徐州諸軍事。
units.en: Prince Mao of Dongping was named general who pacifies the east with command over all Xu military affairs.
units.literal: Prince Mao of Dongping was made general who pacifies the east and area commander for military affairs in Xu Province.

units.zh: 九月，追東安王繇復其爵。
units.en: In the ninth month the late Prince Yao of Dong’an was posthumously rehabilitated and his title restored.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Prince Yao of Dong’an was posthumously pursued and his noble rank restored.

units.zh: 丁丑，封楚王瑋子範爲襄陽王。
units.en: Sima Fan, son of the late Prince Wei of Chu, was created prince of Xiangyang on the dingchou day.
units.literal: On the dingchou day, Prince Wei of Chu’s son Fan was enfeoffed as prince of Xiangyang.

units.zh: 冬十月，流人李特反於蜀。
units.en: The displaced leader Li Te rose in revolt in Shu during the tenth month.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, migrant Li Te rebelled in Shu.

units.zh: 十二月，司空何劭薨。
units.en: In the twelfth month, He Shao, Minister of Works, died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, He Shao, Minister of Works, died.

units.zh: 封齊王冏子冰爲樂安王，英爲濟陽王，超爲淮南王。
units.en: The sons of Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi, were enfeoffed: Bing as Prince of Le’an, Ying as Prince of Jiyang, and Chao as Prince of Huainan.
units.literal: Bing, son of Jiong, Prince of Qi, was enfeoffed as Prince of Le’an, Ying as Prince of Jiyang, and Chao as Prince of Huainan.

units.zh: 是歲，郡國十二旱，六蝗。
units.en: Twelve commanderies suffered drought and six were hit by locust swarms that year.
units.literal: That year, twelve commanderies and kingdoms suffered drought; six had locusts.

units.zh: 太安元年春正月庚子，安東將軍、譙王隨薨。
units.en: Prince Sui of Qiao, general who pacifies the east, died on the gengzi day in the first month of Tai’an.
units.literal: In the first year of Tai’an, spring, first month, on the gengzi day, General Who Pacifies the East, Prince Sui of Qiao, died.

units.zh: 三月癸卯，赦司、冀、兗、豫四州。
units.en: The four metropolitan provinces—Si, Ji, Yan, and Yu—received an amnesty on the guimao day in the third month.
units.literal: In the third month, on the guimao day, Si, Ji, Yan, Yu four provinces were amnestied.

units.zh: 皇太孫尚薨。
units.en: The heir’s son, Prince Shang, died.
units.literal: The imperial grandson-heir Shang died.

units.zh: 夏四月，彗星晝見。
units.en: A comet shone in daylight during the fourth month.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, a broom star was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 五月乙酉，侍中、太宰、領司徒、梁王肜薨。
units.en: On yiyou in the fifth month, Sima Rong, Prince of Liang, who served as Palace Attendant, Grand Zai, and acting Minister over the Masses, died.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on yiyou, Rong, Prince of Liang, Palace Attendant, Grand Steward, and acting Minister over the Masses, died.

units.zh: 以右光祿大夫劉寔爲太傅。
units.en: Liu Shi, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness of the Right, was appointed Grand Tutor.
units.literal: Liu Shi, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness of the Right, was made Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 太尉、河間王顒遣將衙博擊李特於蜀，爲特所敗。
units.en: Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian and Grand Commandant, sent the general Ya Bo to attack Li Te in Shu, but Li Te defeated him.
units.literal: Yong, Prince of Hejian and Grand Commandant, sent the general Ya Bo to attack Li Te in Shu, and he was defeated by Te.

units.zh: 特遂陷梓潼、巴西，害廣漢太守張微，自號大將軍。
units.en: Li Te then captured Zitong and Baxi, killed Zhang Wei, Administrator of Guanghan, and assumed the title Great General.
units.literal: Te then captured Zitong and Baxi, killed Zhang Wei, Administrator of Guanghan, and styled himself Great General.

units.zh: 癸卯，以清河王遐子覃爲皇太子，賜孤寡帛，大酺五日。
units.en: On guimao, Tan, son of Sima Xia, Prince of Qinghe, was made crown prince. Silk was given to the bereft and unsupported, and a public feast was held for five days.
units.literal: On guimao, Tan, son of Xia, Prince of Qinghe, was made imperial heir; silk was bestowed on widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless, and a great feast was held for five days.

units.zh: 以齊王冏爲太師，東海王越爲司空。
units.en: Sima Jiong, Prince of Qi, was appointed Grand Preceptor, and Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai, Minister of Works.
units.literal: Jiong, Prince of Qi, was made Grand Preceptor, and Yue, Prince of Donghai, was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 秋七月，兗、豫、徐、冀等四州大水。
units.en: Catastrophic floods struck Yan, Yu, Xu, and Ji in the seventh month.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Yan, Yu, Xu, Ji, and so on—four provinces—great flood.

units.zh: 冬十月，地震。
units.en: The earth shook in the tenth month.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, earthquake.

units.zh: 十二月丁卯，河間王顒表齊王冏窺伺神器，有無君之心，與成都王穎、新野王歆、范陽王虓同會洛陽，請廢冏還第。
units.en: On the dingmao day Prince Yong of Hejian memorialized that Prince Jiong of Qi was plotting usurpation; together with Prince Ying of Chengdu, Prince Xin of Xinye, and Prince Xiao of Fanyang he converged on Luoyang, demanding that Jiong be dismissed and sent home.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on the dingmao day, Prince Yong of Hejian submitted a memorial that Prince Jiong of Qi spied on the divine vessel and had a heart without regard for the ruler; together with Prince Ying of Chengdu, Prince Xin of Xinye, and Prince Xiao of Fanyang he jointly met at Luoyang, requesting to depose Jiong and return him to his residence.

units.zh: 長沙王乂奉乘輿屯南止車門，攻冏，殺之，幽其諸子于金墉城，廢冏弟北海王寔。
units.en: Prince Yi of Changsha seized the South Halting-Carriage gate with the emperor, stormed Prince Jiong’s position, slew him, penned Jiong’s sons in the Jinyong fortress, and degraded Prince Shi of Beihai.
units.literal: Prince Yi of Changsha, supporting the imperial carriage, encamped at the South Halting-Carriage Gate, attacked Jiong, killed him, confined his various sons in the Jinyong Fortress, and deposed Jiong’s younger brother, Prince Shi of Beihai.

units.zh: 大赦，改元。
units.en: The court proclaimed a general amnesty and adopted a new reign title.
units.literal: A general amnesty; the era name was changed.

units.zh: 以長沙王乂爲太尉、都督中外諸軍事。
units.en: Prince Yi of Changsha was named grand commandant and commander-in-chief of every army.
units.literal: Prince Yi of Changsha was made grand commandant and area commander for all military affairs within and without.

units.zh: 封東萊王蕤子炤爲齊王。
units.en: Sima Zhao, son of Prince Rui of Donglai, was installed as prince of Qi.
units.literal: Prince Rui of Donglai’s son Zhao was enfeoffed as prince of Qi.

units.zh: 二年春正月甲子朔，赦五歲刑。
units.en: The new year opened with remission of all penal labor sentences up to five years.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the jiazi new moon, five-year sentences were amnestied.

units.zh: 三月，李特攻陷益州。
units.en: Li Te overran Yi Province in the third month.
units.literal: In the third month, Li Te attacked and captured Yi Province.

units.zh: 荊州刺史宋岱擊特，斬之，傳首京師。
units.en: Song Dai, the Jing inspector, defeated Li Te, took his head, and sent it to Luoyang.
units.literal: Inspector of Jing Province Song Dai attacked Te, beheaded him, and sent his head to the capital.

units.zh: 夏四月，特子雄復據益州。
units.en: In the fourth month, Li Te’s son Li Xiong again occupied Yi Province.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Te’s son Xiong again occupied Yi Province.

units.zh: 五月，義陽蠻張昌舉兵反，以山都人丘沈爲主，改姓劉氏，僞號漢，建元神鳳，攻破郡縣，南陽太守劉彬，平南將軍羊伊，鎮南大將軍、新野王歆並遇害。
units.en: In the fifth month the Yiyang chieftain Zhang Chang rebelled, set up Qiu Shen of Shandu as a bogus Han emperor surnamed Liu with reign Shenfeng, overran towns, and killed Prefect Liu Bin, General Yang Yi, and Prince Xin of Xinye.
units.literal: In the fifth month, Yiyang Man Zhang Chang raised troops in rebellion, taking Shandu man Qiu Shen as lord, changing the surname to Liu, false title Han, era inception Shenfeng; he broke commanderies and prefectures; Nanyang Prefect Liu Bin, General Who Pacifies the South Yang Yi, and General-in-chief Who Guards the South, Prince Xin of Xinye, together met harm and died.

units.zh: 六月，遣荊州刺史劉弘等討張昌于方城，王師敗績。
units.en: Liu Hong and other Jing commanders marched against Zhang Chang at Fangcheng in the sixth month and were routed.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Inspector of Jing Province Liu Hong and others were dispatched to attack Zhang Chang at Fangcheng; the royal army was defeated.

units.zh: 秋七月，中書令卞粹、侍中馮蓀、河南尹李含等貳於長沙王乂，乂疑而害之。
units.en: In the seventh month Prince Yi suspected Bian Cui, Feng Sun, Li Han, and others of divided loyalty and had them killed.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Director of the Secretariat Bian Cui, Palace Attendant Feng Sun, Intendant of Henan Li Han, and others were double-minded toward Prince Yi of Changsha; Yi suspected them and harmed them.

units.zh: 張昌陷江南諸郡，武陵太守賈隆、零陵太守孔紘、豫章太守閻濟、武昌太守劉根皆遇害。
units.en: Zhang Chang captured the commanderies south of the Yangzi; Jia Long, governor of Wuling; Kong Hong, governor of Lingling; Yan Ji, governor of Yuzhang; and Liu Gen, governor of Wuchang, were all killed.
units.literal: Zhang Chang captured the various commanderies south of the Long River; Wuling Prefect Jia Long, Lingling Prefect Kong Hong, Yuzhang Prefect Yan Ji, and Wuchang Prefect Liu Gen all met harm and died.

units.zh: 昌別帥石冰寇揚州，刺史陳徽與戰，大敗，諸郡盡沒。
units.en: Shi Bing, another of Zhang Chang’s generals, struck Yang Province, shattered Inspector Chen Hui’s army, and cleared every commandery in the region.
units.literal: Chang’s separate commander Shi Bing raided Yang Province; Inspector Chen Hui battled with him, was greatly defeated, and the various commanderies all fell.

units.zh: 臨淮人封雲舉兵應之，自阜陵寇徐州。
units.en: Feng Yun of Linhuai raised troops in response to him and marched from Fuling into Xu Province.
units.literal: A man of Linhuai, Feng Yun, raised troops in response to him, raiding Xu Province from Fuling.

units.zh: 八月，河間王顒、成都王穎舉兵討長沙王乂，帝以乂爲大都督，帥軍禦之。
units.en: In the eighth month Princes Yong and Ying marched against Prince Yi of Changsha, whom the emperor named supreme commander to meet them in the field.
units.literal: In the eighth month, Prince Yong of Hejian and Prince Ying of Chengdu raised troops to attack Prince Yi of Changsha; the emperor made Yi grand commander-in-chief to lead the army in resisting them.

units.zh: 庚申，劉弘及張昌戰於清水，斬之。
units.en: On the gengshen day Liu Hong caught Zhang Chang at the Qing River and took his head.
units.literal: On the gengshen day, Liu Hong battled Zhang Chang at the Qing River and beheaded him.

units.zh: 顒遣其將張方，穎遣其將陸機、牽秀、石超等來逼京師。
units.en: Zhang Fang came at the head of Prince Yong’s host, while Lu Ji, Qian Xiu, and Shi Chao advanced for Prince Ying against Luoyang.
units.literal: Yong dispatched his general Zhang Fang; Ying dispatched his generals Lu Ji, Qian Xiu, Shi Chao, and others to press the capital.

units.zh: 乙丑，帝幸十三里橋，遣將軍皇甫商距方于宜陽。
units.en: The emperor rode to the Thirteen-Li bridge and ordered Huangfu Shang to hold Zhang Fang at Yiyang on the yichou day.
units.literal: On the yichou day the emperor visited the bridge at Thirteen Li and sent General Huangfu Shang to block Zhang Fang at Yiyang.

units.zh: 己巳，帝旋軍于宣武場。
units.en: By the jisi day the imperial camp had withdrawn to the Xuanwu parade ground.
units.literal: On the jisi day the emperor wheeled the army back to the Xuanwu drill ground.

units.zh: 庚午，舍于石樓。
units.en: He spent the gengwu night at the Stone Tower.
units.literal: On the gengwu day he lodged at the Stone Tower.

units.zh: 天中裂，無雲而雷。
units.en: A fissure seemed to open in the heavens, and thunder rolled under a cloudless sky.
units.literal: The sky split midway; without clouds there was thunder.

units.zh: 九月丁丑，帝次于河橋。
units.en: The court camped at the great bridge over the Yellow River on dingchou in the ninth month.
units.literal: On the dingchou day of the ninth month the emperor halted at the River Bridge.

units.zh: 壬午，皇甫商爲張方所敗。
units.en: Huangfu Shang lost to Zhang Fang on the renwu day.
units.literal: On the renwu day Huangfu Shang was defeated by Zhang Fang.

units.zh: 甲申，帝軍于芒山。
units.en: The imperial host took position on Mang Mountain on the jiashen day.
units.literal: On the jiashen day the emperor’s army encamped on Mang Mountain.

units.zh: 丁亥，幸偃師。
units.en: He moved the camp to Yanshi on the dinghai day.
units.literal: On the dinghai day he visited Yanshi.

units.zh: 辛卯，舍于豆田。
units.en: The emperor billeted at the Bean Fields camp on the xinmao day.
units.literal: On the xinmao day he lodged at Bean Fields.

units.zh: 癸巳，尚書右僕射、興晉侯羊玄之卒，帝旋于城東。
units.en: Yang Xuanzhi, marquis of Xingjin and right vice director, died on the guisi day, and the sovereign drew back to the eastern suburbs.
units.literal: On the guisi day, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat, Marquis Yang Xuanzhi of Xingjin, died; the emperor returned to the east of the city.

units.zh: 丙申，進軍緱氏，擊牽秀，走之。
units.en: On bingshen the host struck Qian Xiu at Gongshi and drove him off.
units.literal: On the bingshen day the army advanced to Gongshi, attacked Qian Xiu, and put him to flight.

units.zh: 大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty was issued.
units.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 張方入京城，燒清明、開陽二門，死者萬計。
units.en: Zhang Fang broke into Luoyang, fired the Qingming and Kaiyang gates, and left tens of thousands dead in the streets.
units.literal: Zhang Fang entered the capital, burned the Qingming and Kaiyang gates, and the dead numbered in the tens of thousands.

units.zh: 石超逼乘輿于緱氏。
units.en: Shi Chao cornered the emperor’s escort at Gongshi.
units.literal: Shi Chao pressed the imperial carriage at Gongshi.

units.zh: 冬十月壬寅，帝旋于宮。
units.en: The sovereign re-entered the palace on renyin in the tenth month.
units.literal: In winter, on the renyin day of the tenth month, the emperor returned to the palace.

units.zh: 石超焚緱氏，服御無遺。
units.en: Shi Chao put Gongshi to the torch and destroyed almost every piece of the imperial train.
units.literal: Shi Chao burned Gongshi, leaving nothing of the imperial baggage.

units.zh: 丁未，破牽秀、范陽王虓于東陽門外。
units.en: Outside the Dongyang Gate the loyalists broke Qian Xiu and Prince Xiao of Fanyang on dingwei.
units.literal: On the dingwei day Qian Xiu and Prince Xiao of Fanyang were defeated outside the Dongyang Gate.

units.zh: 戊申，破陸機于建春門，石超走，斬其大將賈崇等十六人，懸首銅駝街。
units.en: At the Jianchun Gate on wushen Lu Ji’s line collapsed, Shi Chao bolted, and sixteen of his senior commanders including Jia Chong were executed, their heads displayed along Copper Camel Street.
units.literal: On the wushen day Lu Ji was defeated at the Jianchun Gate; Shi Chao fled; sixteen of his chief generals including Jia Chong were beheaded and their heads hung along Copper Camel Street.

units.zh: 張方退屯十三里橋。
units.en: Zhang Fang pulled back to the Thirteen-Li bridge.
units.literal: Zhang Fang withdrew and encamped at the Thirteen-Li bridge.

units.zh: 十一月辛巳，星晝隕，聲如雷。
units.en: A meteor blazed across the daytime sky with a thunderclap on xinsi in the eleventh month.
units.literal: On the xinsi day of the eleventh month a star fell in daylight with a noise like thunder.

units.zh: 王師攻方壘，不利。
units.en: Imperial troops stormed Zhang Fang’s earthworks and were thrown back.
units.literal: The royal army attacked Fang’s ramparts without success.

units.zh: 方決千金堨，水碓皆涸。
units.en: Zhang Fang cut the Qianjin dike and drained every millpond that powered the city’s mills.
units.literal: Fang breached the Qianjin weir, and the water-powered mills all ran dry.

units.zh: 乃發王公奴婢手舂給兵廩，一品已下不從征者、男子十三以上皆從役。
units.en: Slaves from noble households were set to grinding army rations by hand, and every boy thirteen or older not already under arms was dragooned into labor.
units.literal: Thereupon princes’ and dukes’ slaves and maids were ordered to pound grain by hand for the army granaries; males of thirteen sui and above among all ranks below the first who were not on campaign were all put to corvée.

units.zh: 又發奴助兵，號爲四部司馬。
units.en: More bond servants were drafted into four provisional “Sima” brigades.
units.literal: Slaves were again levied to reinforce the troops, titled the “Four Divisions Sima.”

units.zh: 公私窮踧，米石萬錢。
units.en: State and gentry alike were ruined, and rice sold for ten thousand cash a stone.
units.literal: Public and private means were exhausted; a stone of rice cost ten thousand cash.

units.zh: 詔命所至，一城而已。
units.en: Imperial authority now extended barely beyond the walls of a single city.
units.literal: Wherever edicts could reach, there was only one city left.

units.zh: 壬寅夜，赤氣竟天，隱隱有聲。
units.en: Crimson aurora smothered the heavens on the renyin night, throbbing with a low roar.
units.literal: On the renyin night red vapors filled the sky with a faint rumbling.

units.zh: 丙辰，地震。
units.en: The earth shook on the bingchen day.
units.literal: On the bingchen day there was an earthquake.

units.zh: 癸亥，東海王越執長沙王乂，幽於金墉城，尋爲張方所害。
units.en: Prince Yue of Donghai arrested Prince Yi, locked him in Jinyong, and left him to be murdered by Zhang Fang’s men shortly afterward.
units.literal: On the guihai day, Prince Yue of Donghai seized Prince Yi of Changsha, confined him in the Jinyong Fortress, and soon he was harmed by Zhang Fang.

units.zh: 甲子，大赦。
units.en: A general amnesty followed on the jiazi day.
units.literal: On the jiazi day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

units.zh: 丙寅，揚州秀才周玘、前南平內史王矩、前吳興內史顧祕起義軍以討石冰。
units.en: On bingyin Zhou Qi, Wang Ju, and Gu Mi mobilized gentry militia from the lower Yangzi to march against Shi Bing.
units.literal: On the bingyin day, recommended scholar Zhou Qi of Yangzhou, former Nanping Administrator Wang Ju, and former Wuxing Administrator Gu Mi raised volunteer armies to attack Shi Bing.

units.zh: 冰退，自臨淮趣壽陽。
units.en: Shi Bing fell back from Linhuai toward Shouyang.
units.literal: Bing retreated from Linhuai toward Shouyang.

units.zh: 征東將軍劉準遣廣陵度支陳敏擊冰。
units.en: Liu Zhun, general who conquers the east, sent Chen Min, the Guangling grain officer, in pursuit of Shi Bing.
units.literal: General Who Conquers the East Liu Zhun dispatched Chen Min, grain intendant of Guangling, to strike Bing.

units.zh: 李雄自郫城攻益州刺史羅尚，尚委城而遁，雄盡有成都之地。
units.en: Li Xiong marched from Pi against Luo Shang; Luo Shang fled and abandoned the province, and Li Xiong seized the whole Chengdu plain.
units.literal: Li Xiong attacked Yi Province Inspector Luo Shang from Pi city; Shang abandoned the city and fled; Xiong took possession of all Chengdu territory.

units.zh: 封鮮卑段勿塵爲遼西公。
units.en: Duan Wuchen of the Xianbei was invested as duke of Liaoxi.
units.literal: The Xianbei chief Duan Wuchen was enfeoffed as duke of Liaoxi.

units.zh: 永興元年春正月丙午，尚書令樂廣卒。
units.en: On bingwu in the first month of spring in Yongxing 1, Le Guang, Director of the Secretariat, died.
units.literal: In spring, in the first month of the first year of Yongxing, on bingwu, Le Guang, Director of the Secretariat, died.

units.zh: 成都王穎自鄴諷于帝，乃大赦，改元爲永安。
units.en: From Ye, Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, pressured the emperor by suggestion; a general amnesty followed, and the era name was changed to Yongan.
units.literal: Ying, Prince of Chengdu, from Ye hinted to the emperor, and so there was a great amnesty and the era name was changed to Yongan.

units.zh: 帝逼于河間王顒，密詔雍州刺史劉沈、秦州刺史皇甫重以討之。
units.en: Pressed by Sima Yong, Prince of Hejian, the emperor secretly ordered Liu Shen, Inspector of Yongzhou, and Huangfu Zhong, Inspector of Qinzhou, to attack him.
units.literal: The emperor was pressured by Yong, Prince of Hejian, and secretly ordered Liu Shen, Inspector of Yongzhou, and Huangfu Zhong, Inspector of Qinzhou, to attack him.

units.zh: 沈舉兵攻長安，爲顒所敗。
units.en: Liu Shen raised troops against Chang’an, but Sima Yong defeated him.
units.literal: Shen raised troops and attacked Chang’an, but was defeated by Yong.

units.zh: 張方大掠洛中，還長安。
units.en: Zhang Fang plundered Luoyang heavily and returned to Chang’an.
units.literal: Zhang Fang greatly plundered the Luoyang area and returned to Chang’an.

units.zh: 於是軍中大餒，人相食。
units.en: The army then suffered severe famine, and people resorted to cannibalism.
units.literal: At this, the army suffered great hunger, and people ate one another.

units.zh: 以成都王穎爲丞相。
units.en: Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu, was made Chancellor.
units.literal: Ying, Prince of Chengdu, was made Chancellor.

units.zh: 穎遣從事中郎成夔等以兵五萬屯十二城門，殿中宿所忌者，穎皆殺之，以三部兵代宿衛。
units.en: Ying sent Cheng Kui and others with fifty thousand troops to garrison the twelve city gates. He killed everyone on palace duty whom he suspected and replaced the palace guard with troops from the Three Divisions.
units.literal: Ying sent Attendant Gentleman Cheng Kui and others with fifty thousand troops to camp at the twelve city gates; all those on palace duty whom Ying feared, he killed, replacing the palace guards with troops from the Three Divisions.

units.zh: 二月乙酉，廢皇后羊氏，幽于金墉城，黜皇太子覃復爲清河王。
units.en: Empress Yang was cast into Jinyong on yiyou in the second month, and Crown Prince Tan was reduced once more to prince of Qinghe.
units.literal: On the yiyou day of the second month Empress Yang was deposed and confined in the Jinyong Fortress; Crown Prince Tan was degraded again to prince of Qinghe.

units.zh: 三月，陳敏攻石冰，斬之，揚、徐二州平。
units.en: Chen Min killed Shi Bing in the third month, and calm returned to Yang and Xu.
units.literal: In the third month Chen Min attacked Shi Bing, beheaded him, and Yang and Xu provinces were pacified.

units.zh: 河間王顒表請立成都王穎爲太弟。
units.en: Prince Yong asked the throne to name Prince Ying of Chengdu as heir apparent.
units.literal: Prince Yong of Hejian submitted a memorial requesting that Prince Ying of Chengdu be established as imperial younger brother and heir.

units.zh: 戊申，詔曰：「朕以不德，纂承鴻緒，于茲十有五載。
units.en: On the wushen day an edict began: “Fifteen years have passed since I, unworthy, inherited the great mandate.
units.literal: On the wushen day an edict stated: “I, lacking virtue, have succeeded to the vast line; here now fifteen years.

units.zh: 禍亂滔天，姦逆仍起，至乃幽廢重宮，宗廟圮絕。
units.en: Disaster has mounted to the skies, rebels have followed one after another, I was cast into the inner palace in disgrace, and the sacrifices nearly failed altogether.
units.literal: Calamity and rebellion have swelled to Heaven; traitors have arisen in succession, so that I was even confined and deposed in the deep palace, and the ancestral temples were cut off.

units.zh: 成都王穎溫仁惠和，克平暴亂。
units.en: Prince Ying of Chengdu is gentle, generous, and just, and he has crushed the violence that tore the realm.
units.literal: Prince Ying of Chengdu is warm, humane, kind, and harmonious, and has been able to pacify violence and chaos.

units.zh: 其以穎爲皇太弟、都督中外諸軍事，丞相如故。」
units.en: Let him therefore be named imperial younger brother and heir, commander of every army, while retaining the chancellorship.”
units.literal: Let Ying be made imperial younger brother and heir, area commander for all military affairs within and without, and remain chancellor as before.”

units.zh: 大赦，賜鰥寡高年帛三匹，大酺五日。
units.en: A general amnesty followed, three bolts of silk went to each destitute elder, and the capital celebrated for five days.
units.literal: A general amnesty; widowers, widows, and the aged were granted three bolts of silk; great feasting for five days.

units.zh: 丙辰，盜竊太廟服器。
units.en: Robbers plundered the ritual regalia from the Grand Temple on bingchen.
units.literal: On the bingchen day thieves stole the vestments and vessels of the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 以太尉顒爲太宰，太傅劉寔爲太尉。
units.en: Prince Yong moved from grand commandant to grand steward, and Liu Shi from grand tutor to grand commandant.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Yong was made grand steward; Grand Tutor Liu Shi was made grand commandant.

units.zh: 六月，新作三城門。
units.en: Work finished on three new city gates in the sixth month.
units.literal: In the sixth month three new city gates were built.

units.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，右衛將軍陳眕以詔召百僚入殿中，因勒兵討成都王穎。
units.en: On the bingshen new moon of autumn’s seventh month, General of the Right Guards Chen Zhen used an edict to summon the hundred officials into the palace hall, then led troops against Prince Ying of Chengdu.
units.literal: In autumn, on the bingshen new moon of the seventh month, General of the Right Guards Chen Zhen used an edict to summon the hundred officials into the palace, then led troops to attack Prince Ying of Chengdu.

units.zh: 戊戌，大赦，復皇后羊氏及皇太子覃。
units.en: Empress Yang and Crown Prince Tan were restored on wuxu under a general amnesty.
units.literal: On the wuxu day a general amnesty restored Empress Yang and Crown Prince Tan.

units.zh: 己亥，司徒王戎、東海王越、高密王簡、平昌公模、吳王晏、豫章王熾、襄陽王範、右僕射荀藩等奉帝北征。
units.en: On jihai Wang Rong, Prince Yue, Prince Jian, Sima Mo, Prince Yan, Prince Chi, Prince Fan, and Xun Fan convoyed the emperor north.
units.literal: On the jihai day Minister of Education Wang Rong, Prince Yue of Donghai, Prince Jian of Gaomi, Duke Mo of Pingchang, Prince Yan of Wu, Prince Chi of Yuzhang, Prince Fan of Xiangyang, and Right Vice Director Xun Fan and others escorted the emperor on a northern expedition.

units.zh: 至安陽，眾十餘萬，穎遣其將石超距戰。
units.en: The army swelled past a hundred thousand at Anyang, where Prince Ying sent Shi Chao to bar the road.
units.literal: When they reached Anyang the host exceeded one hundred thousand; Ying dispatched his general Shi Chao to resist in battle.

units.zh: 己未，六軍敗績于蕩陰，矢及乘輿，百官分散，侍中嵇紹死之。
units.en: At Dangyin on jiwei the imperial army collapsed, arrows riddled the imperial coach, the courtiers fled, and Ji Shao died shielding the throne.
units.literal: On the jiwei day the six armies were defeated at Dangyin; arrows reached the imperial carriage; the hundred officials scattered; Palace Attendant Ji Shao died in the engagement.

units.zh: 帝傷頰，中三矢，亡六璽。
units.en: The sovereign took three hits in the cheek and lost six of the dynasty’s jade seals in the rout.
units.literal: The emperor was wounded in the cheek, struck by three arrows, and lost six of the imperial seals.

units.zh: 帝遂幸超軍，餒甚，超進水，左右奉秋桃。
units.en: Starving, he fell into Shi Chao’s lines; Chao gave him water while attendants found late peaches.
units.literal: The emperor thereupon visited Chao’s camp, was extremely hungry; Chao advanced water, and attendants offered autumn peaches.

units.zh: 超遣弟熙奉帝之鄴，穎帥群官迎謁道左。
units.en: Shi Chao’s brother Shi Xi escorted the emperor toward Ye, where Prince Ying knelt with his entire staff along the road.
units.literal: Chao sent his younger brother Xi to convoy the emperor to Ye; Ying led the host of officials to bow in welcome by the roadside.

units.zh: 帝下輿涕泣，其夕幸于穎軍。
units.en: He stepped down from the coach in tears and spent the night in Prince Ying’s encampment.
